excluded: complete TCP, general opening/options and timestamps
ACK decimation, GRO and receiver SWS optimization
no-flight persist, congestion and fast recovery

ACK-DELAY.interpretation: RFC 9293 MUST-40 bounds ACK delay below 500ms; SHLD-18/19 support delayed ACK and ACK at least every second full-sized segment or 2*RMSS new bytes. Choose a fixed first-segment deadline of 40ms (configurable 1..499ms), RMSS=4, independent of the sender RTO.

ACK-GAP.interpretation: Out-of-order, duplicate/overlapping, gap-filling, clipped, FIN or zero-window arrivals retain immediate cumulative ACK. Only fully accepted in-order data with no queued gap or FIN is eligible for deferral.

ACK-SCOPE.interpretation: Reuse parent data/ACK-window/FIN/RTO/SYN semantics. Delay only plain data in ESTABLISHED/FIN-WAIT-1/FIN-WAIT-2; a real outgoing ACK of current RCV.NXT cancels the pending ACK, including piggyback, window update and FIN. No callback protocol actions, ACK decimation, GRO, congestion control or universal output/timing proof.
